sources.title: transformers/docs/source/en/model_doc/umt5.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: As part of our contribution, we release: (i) an improved and refreshed mC4 multilingual corpus consisting of 29 trillion characters across 107 languages, and (ii) a suite of pretrained umT5 model checkpoints trained with UniMax sampling. Google has released the following variants: google/umt5-small google/umt5-base google/umt5-xl google/umt5-xxl.
